verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents itself as 100% open source and deployable on-premise, with production self-hosting on Kubernetes via Helm, a zero-config development Helm chart for Minikube, and an On Prem tier. A community user reports easily deploying the open-source version, and the llms.txt probe describes it as a self-hostable Segment alternative. Missing for 10: a feature-complete deployment requires a Kubernetes cluster (heavier operational footprint), and the hands-on corroboration predates the current Kubernetes-native architecture.
